description: This file defines the 'Location' model class within the Opencart admin module, handling CRUD operations for location entities in the database.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Model class managing location data, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting location records in the database.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Creates a new location record in the database with provided data, returns the new location ID.

methods.name: editLocation
methods.description: Updates an existing location record identified by location_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes the location record corresponding to the given location_id.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific location record by its location_id.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Fetches multiple location records based on optional filters, sort, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLocations
methods.description: Returns the total count of location records.
